actions.objective: Download the referenced YouTube video, extract the full ordered list of player inputs/moves from the video, and write /app/solution.txt with one move per line.
required_artifacts: local copy or verified download of the referenced video
required_behaviors: Acquire the referenced video content from the provided URL.
Determine the complete ordered sequence of moves entered by the player.
Write each move on its own line in /app/solution.txt using the exact move text as shown/derived from the video.
known_invalid_patterns: Guessing or inventing moves without video evidence.
Treating file existence or non-empty output as sufficient evidence.
Using partial transcript or partial move list as completion.
verification_plan: Download or otherwise access the referenced video.
Extract the move sequence from the video content with evidence.
Write /app/solution.txt and verify its contents against the extracted sequence.
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the downloaded/accessible video content.
Receipt-backed evidence of the extracted complete move list.
Receipt-backed evidence that /app/solution.txt contains the same complete move list, one per line.
notes: If direct download is unavailable, use any visible alternate route that still yields the actual video content and transcript/move evidence.

actions.command: pwd && ls -la && command -v yt-dlp || true && command -v youtube-dl || true && command -v ffmpeg || true && command -v python3 || true && command -v curl || true && command -v wget || true
